WHAT: parakeet-rs 0.3.4 wraps ONNX Runtime for Parakeet/NeMo models. Has real downstream users (dictee app, transcribe-rs). Auto-falls back to CPU if GPU EP fails.

HOW:
```toml
parakeet-rs = { version = "0.3.4", features = ["directml"] }
```
```rust
use parakeet_rs::{Parakeet, ExecutionConfig, ExecutionProvider};
let config = ExecutionConfig::new()
    .with_execution_provider(ExecutionProvider::Directml)
    .parallel_execution(false)   // REQUIRED for DirectML
    .memory_pattern(false);       // REQUIRED for DirectML
let model = Parakeet::from_pretrained("path/to/model", Some(config))?;
```

CRITICAL GOTCHA: DirectML requires ORT_SEQUENTIAL + mem_pattern=false. transcribe-rs excludes DirectML from 'Auto' EP set for this reason — must be explicitly selected.

DLL BUNDLING (ship next to .exe, NOT relying on System32):
- onnxruntime.dll: ~150MB
- DirectML.dll: ~13MB (System32 version conflict bug — always ship own copy)
- Total: ~170-200MB uncompressed

ONNX MODEL IDs:
- TDT v2: istupakov/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2-onnx (encoder + decoder ONNX files)
- CTC: onnx-community/parakeet-ctc-0.6b-ONNX (~2.3GB FP32)
- INT8 quantized variants exist, ~2-3x faster on low-power hardware

HARDWARE: Covers all DX12 GPUs — NVIDIA Kepler+, AMD GCN+, Intel Haswell HD+. Windows 10/11 with modern drivers.

WARNING: DirectML.dll version conflict — Windows ships old version in System32 that causes crashes. Always bundle correct version next to .exe.
